answer: Charge for re-entry, not entry. Every identity pays nothing to register, but each new session of trust must be bought by presenting a hardware-backed enclave quote whose measurement was first published on a public wharf of attested builds. A farm of clones can mint keys, yet none can answer a live challenge chained to a measurement nobody has attested; and a stale measurement on the shale of an old batch decays, so rented hardware stops counting. The honest fable is boring: one device, one lineage, renewals visible to all, so volume becomes the only cost and it never falls.
